The HTML device gallery now shows all five devices with their real Simulator surrounds and camera cutouts. iPhone Duo outer and inner screens remain first, with readable labels and full-resolution PNG links.

The package no longer declares Unity 2022.3 as a minimum Editor version. **2022.3.62f2 and 6000.6.5f1 are verified versions, not requirements.** Earlier Editors may work but have not been verified; compatible Device Simulator APIs and package dependencies are still necessary.

[Open the framed gallery](https://dghn.github.io/editorcraft-device-simulator-tools/favorite-gallery/)

```text
https://github.com/dghn/editorcraft-device-simulator-tools.git#v0.4.2
```

Validation: five fresh framed exports from Unity 6000.6.5f1, transparent exteriors and device frames visually checked; static integrity passed for 181 profiles / 676 orientations / 130 overlays; all seven installer tests passed. No earlier-Editor compatibility or fresh clean-install verification is claimed by this patch.
